official.parity: recompute each final score and compare saved bound official-final.json

size_auxiliary.aggregation: COCO uniform category macro and 101-point sampled precision
size_auxiliary.boundary: COCO inclusive bounds; exact1024/9216 can occur in adjacent groups

ignored_semantics: Reference union ignored-region rasterization removes GT/dets with >=0.5 overlap. Remaining score-zero same-class GT become crowd/ignore; category11 excluded. Truncation/occlusion retained in source/counts and not grounds for removal.
curves: diagnostic_AP is internal macro validation only, never official AP; training AP unavailable
resources: CPU only; no feature/model inference or checkpoint torch deserialization
negative_size_auxiliary_policy: Clamp negative prediction width/height to zero for COCO/TIDE only; keep every box, score and class; original official input unchanged.
ground_truth_profile_boundary: Descriptive profile counts are disjoint small<=1024, 1024<medium<=9216, large>9216; metric ranges use COCO inclusive bounds.
